q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of an electric scooter?
title: Electric scooter carbon footprint per vehicle
short: The battery pack is usually the largest single item: use the cell or pack supplier's figure per kWh times the pack size. Add the frame, motor, controller, body panels and tyres, then the assembly plant's energy per scooter built.

ul: Lithium-ion battery pack, counted per kWh of capacity.
Hub or mid-drive motor and controller.
Steel frame, plastic body panels, tyres and wiring.
Frame welding and painting if done in-house.
Battery pack assembly if done in-house.

p: Report per scooter by model and battery capacity. Charging electricity belongs to the use phase, not the factory figure.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per vehicle (one month)
lines: Plant total: 71,000 / 2,000 = 35.5 kg CO2 per vehicle
Add battery pack, motor, frame and body for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
